reasons.title: Registration number belongs to a different product
reasons.message: A4-6238 is registered to Artheget EZ by Getz Pharma Nigeria Limited, but this pack shows product name "Malacure Forte" and manufacturer / licence holder "Sunrise Pharma Nig. Ltd". A real number on the wrong product is a common sign of a falsified medicine.
reasons.nextStep: Don't use it. Show the pack to a pharmacist and report it to NAFDAC (0800-162-3322).
